sentences.cn_text: 如果你正前往英国最大图书零售商沃特斯通书店最近的分店，寻找萨塞克斯公爵夫人的新儿童读物《长椅》，可能需要做好四处搜寻的准备；比尔·克林顿和詹姆斯·帕特森合著的新惊悚小说《总统的女儿》情况可能也是如此。
sentences.en_text: If you’re heading for your nearest branch of Waterstones, the biggest book retailer in the UK, in search of the Duchess of Sussex’s new children’s book The Bench, you might have to be prepared to hunt around a bit; the same may be true of The President’s Daughter, the new thriller by Bill Clinton and James Patterson.

sentences.cn_text: 这两本书均将于下周由企鹅兰登书屋（PRH）出版，该公司目前正与沃特斯通书店陷入对峙。
sentences.en_text: Both of these books are published next week by Penguin Random House (PRH), a company currently involved in a stand-off with Waterstones.

sentences.cn_text: 问题始于去年年底，当时企鹅兰登书屋证实已对沃特斯通书店实施了「非常高水平」的信用额度限制。
sentences.en_text: The problem began late last year, when PRH confirmed that it had introduced a credit limit with Waterstones “at a very significant level”.

sentences.cn_text: 行业杂志《书商》报道称，沃特斯通书店各分店经理接到指示，将企鹅兰登书屋的图书从书桌、展示区和橱窗等显眼位置撤下，「悄悄地将它们归入相应的分类区域」。
sentences.en_text: The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were “quietly retiring them to their relevant sections”.

sentences.cn_text: 企鹅兰登书屋拒绝就此事发表评论，但沃特斯通书店的一位发言人告诉我：「沃特斯通书店目前正在企鹅兰登书屋缩减的信用条件下运营，该出版商是英国唯一对我们经营能力施加限制的出版商。」
sentences.en_text: PRH declined to comment on the issue, but a spokesperson for Waterstones told me: “Waterstones are currently operating with reduced credit terms from PRH, the only publisher in the UK to place any limitations on our ability to trade.

sentences.cn_text: 「我们并未抵制企鹅兰登书屋的图书，但我们正在竭尽全力确保尽管整体库存水平降低，顾客仍能获得良好的供应。」「我们希望随着门店重新开业，正常状态能够恢复，我们也能够进行适当的采购。」
sentences.en_text: We are not boycotting PRH titles but we are doing our utmost to ensure that availability for customers remains good despite the lower overall levels of stock.” “We are hopeful with our shops now open again that normality will return and that we will be allowed to buy appropriately.

sentences.cn_text: 当然，我们的门店生意异常火爆。
sentences.en_text: Certainly, our shops are exceptionally busy.

sentences.cn_text: 我们五月本月推荐图书的销量超过了2018年以来任何一个月份。
sentences.en_text: The sales for our May Books of the Month surpassed any month since 2018.”

sentences.cn_text: 与此同时，企鹅兰登书屋的作者们成了受损方。
sentences.en_text: In the meantime, PRH authors have been the losers.

sentences.cn_text: 知名的企鹅兰登书屋作者可能会受到一些影响，但那些通常依靠沃特斯通书店员工热情推广不太知名作家作品的中等层级作者，将会祈祷争端早日结束。
sentences.en_text: Big-name PRH authors may suffer a bit, but it’s those mid-list authors, who normally rely on Waterstones staff’s passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers, who will be praying for an end to the dispute.

sentences.cn_text: 此事发生之际，作者们已经在担忧企鹅兰登书屋与另一大出版商西蒙与舒斯特拟议合并的后果——英国非联盟出版商数量的减少可能导致竞价战减少、预付款降低以及出版内容趋于同质化。
sentences.en_text: It comes at a time when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher, Simon & Schuster — the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published.

sentences.cn_text: 文学经纪人安德鲁·劳尼表示：「这都是权力集中这一更广泛变革的组成部分。」
sentences.en_text: “This is all part of a wider change towards concentration of power,” says literary agent Andrew Lownie.

sentences.cn_text: 「出版行业在谈论作者和员工的多元化，但它同样需要多样化的途径来传递思想内容、提供选择和呈现不同声音。」
sentences.en_text: “The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.

sentences.cn_text: 「毕竟，近年来许多最具趣味的图书都出自小型出版商。」
sentences.en_text: After all, many of the most interesting books in recent years have come from small publishers.”

sentences.cn_text: 我们将拭目以待，这种多元化是否会成为出版商当前为应对所有竞争者而必须做大做强的牺牲品。
sentences.en_text: We shall see whether that plurality is a casualty of the current need among publishers to be big enough to take on all-comers.

sentences.en_text: Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections?

sentences.cn_text: 为使它们容易被注意到。
sentences.en_text: To make them easily noticeable.

sentences.cn_text: 为遵守企鹅兰登书屋的要求。
sentences.en_text: To comply with PRH’s requirement.

sentences.cn_text: 为回应企鹅兰登书屋的商业举措。
sentences.en_text: To respond to PRH’s business move.

sentences.cn_text: 为以系统化方式陈列它们。
sentences.en_text: To arrange them in a systematic way.

sentences.cn_text: 他们的顾客依然忠诚。
sentences.en_text: Their customers remain loyal.

sentences.cn_text: 信用额度限制将被解除。
sentences.en_text: The credit limit will be removed.

sentences.cn_text: 他们的库存被低估了。
sentences.en_text: Their stock is underestimated.

sentences.cn_text: 图书市场相当疲软。
sentences.en_text: The book market is rather slack.

sentences.cn_text: 当前争端可能产生什么后果？
sentences.en_text: What can be one consequence of the current dispute?

sentences.cn_text: 中等层级企鹅兰登书屋作者的图书销量大幅下滑。
sentences.en_text: Sales of books by mid-list PRH writers fall off considerably.

sentences.cn_text: 不太知名的企鹅兰登书屋作者成为批评对象。
sentences.en_text: Lesser-known PRH writers become the target of criticism.

sentences.cn_text: 沃特斯通书店员工对推广知名作者的图书犹豫不决。
sentences.en_text: Waterstones staff hesitate to promote big-name authors’ books.

sentences.cn_text: 沃特斯通书店分店收入严重下降。
sentences.en_text: Waterstones branches suffer a severe reduction in revenue.

sentences.cn_text: 以下哪项陈述最能代表劳尼的观点？
sentences.en_text: Which of the following statements best represents Lownie’s view?

sentences.cn_text: 小型出版商应该团结一致。
sentences.en_text: Small publishers ought to stick together.

sentences.cn_text: 大型出版商将丧失其主导地位。
sentences.en_text: Big publishers will lose their dominance.

sentences.cn_text: 出版行业正经历艰难时期。
sentences.en_text: The publishing industry is having a hard time.

sentences.cn_text: 出版商合并是一个令人担忧的趋势。
sentences.en_text: The merger of publishers is a worrying trend.
